comparison.objective: Index an off-balance rotary table and lock it with a pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a gravity-loaded rotary axis at a target while inserting a separate pin.
comparison.success_condition: Table reaches 90 degrees and remains physically pinned there.
comparison.reason: This is a close hold-and-lock neighbor, but it locks a gross indexed pose by pin insertion rather than counterholding a fine threaded setting during jam-nut tightening and validating repeated motion.
